positions.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering (WFM)
positions.description:
Oversee design and development of projects focused on workforce management, labor demand generation, data integration, report generation, and schedule generation for stores and clubs. Establish and guide cloud computing budget. Collaborate with global developers to preserve internal and external application backlogs. Supervise 10-30 associates on smaller teams to complete work and ensure on-schedule budget execution and delivery. 
• Delivered a new multi cloud-based labor demand calculation application for a fraction of the cost of previous solution which runs in under two hours (versus days) for 4,800 stores.
• Maintained spending on $2M budget by lowering old spend and employing new spending for new projects.
• Instrumental in the delivery of the largest workforce management system ever (1+ million associates in several countries.)
• Raised associate engagement by several points based on associate opinion surveys.
• Led team to complete multiple key business applications providing new business processes for store and market managers better schedule staffing. 
• Designed and lead the development of an API-based integration process to send associate information for 800,000 plus associates from internal HR systems to an external scheduling system within minutes versus two days.

patents.title: Systems and methods for management of digitally emulated shadow resources
patents.description: Various aspects and embodiments facilitate management of digitally emulated physical resources. Users can access a management system to create pairings between digitally emulated resources and physical resources. The paired resources can be consistently managed through the system, such that any user from any source can access and dynamically reserve physical and digital resources. In further embodiments, the system can create pairings between the digital emulation and physical resources based on merge operations performed on multiple digital emulations of resources, copy and pasting for other digital emulation of resources, and digital altering of existing resources. The system enables efficient management, control, and implements security for digital and physical resources using, for example, a "digital room." Security rules and enforcement can be specified within the digital rooms based on access rights, content displays, and can be specific to each resource controlled by the digital room.
